I will finish this wheat crop now in the field, manage water carefully, and harvest it in early summer. After that, I will sow summer maize right away on the same land so I do not lose time or soil moisture. I will not plant too many scattered crops, because that takes more labor and is harder to manage. I will use improved or hybrid seed where it helps yield and standability, but I will not chase fancy methods. I will use moderate fertilizer, enough irrigation for the key stages, and only a few pesticide sprays when really needed, because I want stable production and lower cost.
